Program at a Glance

ICBR is a conference aiming to provide an international forum for researchers from robotics, bioengineering, materials science, neuroscience, and related fields to share recent advances, discuss common challenges, and explore future directions at the interface of engineering and biology.
The conference will include plenary sessions, keynote sessions, contributed paper sessions, workshops and tutorial sessions.
